Carbon Farming Initiative Amendment Bill 2014 - Second Reading - Criticise the Direct Action policy
Carbon Farming Initiative Amendment Bill 2014 - Second Reading - Agree with the bill's main idea

The majority agreed to an [amendment](http://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;db=CHAMBER;id=chamber%2Fhansards%2Fe89a1618-fea8-466d-ab43-821cf296f483%2F0222;query=Id%3A%22chamber%2Fhansards%2Fe89a1618-fea8-466d-ab43-821cf296f483%2F0000%22) that either the [Emissions Reduction Assurance Committee](http://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd1415a/15bd023) (created by this bill) or the [Department of the Environment](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Department_of_the_Environment_%28Australia%29) should publish a draft of a [methodology determination](http://www.climatechange.gov.au/reducing-carbon/carbon-farming-initiative/methodologies) and give the public at least two weeks to make submissions on that draft. Currently, the public have at least forty days to make submissions. ###Methodology determinations Methodology determinations are detailed rules that farmers and land managers must follow to earn [carbon credits](http://www.cleanenergyregulator.gov.au/ANREU/Concise-description-of-units/Australian-carbon-credit-units/Pages/default.aspx) for particular carbon reduction activities under the [Carbon Farming Initiative](http://www.daff.gov.au/climatechange/cfi). ###Carbon Farming Initiative The [Carbon Farming Initiative](http://www.daff.gov.au/climatechange/cfi) lets farmers and land managers earn [carbon credits](http://www.cleanenergyregulator.gov.au/ANREU/Concise-description-of-units/Australian-carbon-credit-units/Pages/default.aspx) by reducing greenhouse gas emissions and [storing carbon](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carbon_sequestration) in vegetation and soils by changing their agricultural and land management practices. ###Background to the bill The Emissions Reduction Fund is a key part of the Coalition Government's [Direct Action policy](http://www.abc.net.au/news/2013-12-20/coalition-climate-change-direct-action-policy-explained/5067188), which was an [election commitment](https://www.liberal.org.au/our-plan/envir

Introduced the Carbon Farming Initiative Amendment Bill to establish the Emissions Reduction Fund with an initial $2.55 billion commitment, arguing the carbon tax was a $7.6 billion hit on the economy in its first year for just a 0.1 per cent emissions cut, and reduced the required carbon storage permanence period from 100 years to 25.

Defended the government's Emissions Reduction Fund, allocated $2.55 billion across the forward estimates, citing Blantyre Farms in his electorate, which has earned 20,000 carbon credits for capturing piggery biogas, and argued the European emissions trading scheme had simply exported emissions to China rather than cutting them.

Opposed the Carbon Farming Initiative Amendment Bill, citing a fall of 17.2 million tonnes, or 10 per cent, in National Electricity Market emissions since the carbon price began, and a Fairfax Media survey of 35 economists in which only two preferred Direct Action over a market-based carbon price.
